# S-032 · ICT-gebruik bij bedrijven (ICT, kennis en economie 2023)

## What it says

- In 2021, 31 percent of Dutch firms with 10 or more staff employed an ICT specialist, so most did not [W4-025].
- In 2022, 21 percent let their own ICT specialists follow training [W4-026].
